raw_response:
The issuer shows solid profitability (net margin ~12% and EBIT margin ~16%) and adequate liquidity (current ratio ~1.9). Leverage is moderate with liabilities of 2,198M exceeding equity of 1,609M (debt-like pressure), but the balance sheet still appears stable given the strong earnings generation. Overall, this supports an investment-grade profile, though not at the higher tiers.

DECISION: BBB+
